records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for setting up Silver Logistics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Silver Logistics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite despite two nudges (email:ec77b88e, da25a933). Kickoff did happen as scheduled (calendar:ba6762c7), a positive signal, and 8 days remain, but no customer reply or written commitment, so unaided activation is uncertain.

draft.subject: Following up on yesterday's kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff yesterday — good to talk through what Silver Logistics wants to get out of Wrenfield.

The usual first step is getting a first project set up, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and help you get that first project started together — just name a time that works.

Best,
Priya
